---
- name: Configure VLAN trunk sub-interfaces on node2/node3 and route via node1
  hosts: linux_hosts
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure 8021q module is loaded
      community.general.modprobe:
        name: 8021q
        state: present

    - name: Create VLAN connection on the trunk interface
      community.general.nmcli:
        type: vlan
        conn_name: "vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
        ifname: "vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
        vlandev: "{{ trunk_iface }}"
        vlanid: "{{ vlan_id }}"
        ip4: "{{ vlan_ip }}"
        gw4: "{{ router_vlan_ip }}"
        state: present
        autoconnect: true

    - name: Bring the VLAN connection up
      community.general.nmcli:
        type: vlan
        conn_name: "vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
        state: up

    - name: Check whether the route to the peer VLAN subnet is already configured
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "nmcli -g ipv4.routes connection show vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
      register: existing_routes
      changed_when: false

    - name: Add explicit route to the peer VLAN subnet via node1
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "nmcli connection modify vlan{{ vlan_id }} +ipv4.routes '{{ peer_net }} {{ router_vlan_ip }}'"
      when: peer_net not in existing_routes.stdout
      register: route_mod

    - name: Reapply the VLAN connection so the route takes effect
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "nmcli connection up vlan{{ vlan_id }}"
      when: route_mod is changed

- name: Configure VyOS router node1 with VLAN sub-interfaces
  hosts: router
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Check current VyOS interface configuration
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: /opt/vyatta/bin/vyatta-op-cmd-wrapper show configuration commands
      register: vyos_current
      changed_when: false

    - name: Apply VyOS VLAN configuration
      ansible.builtin.shell: |

        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
        configure
        set interfaces ethernet eth1 vif 10 address "10.10.10.1/24"
        set interfaces ethernet eth1 vif 20 address "10.10.20.1/24"
        commit
        save
        exit
        '
      register: vyos_config
      when: >
        "set interfaces ethernet eth1 vif 10 address '10.10.10.1/24'" not in vyos_current.stdout
        or "set interfaces ethernet eth1 vif 20 address '10.10.20.1/24'" not in vyos_current.stdout
ANTRIEB_EOF
